acceptanceCriteria: API, UI, URL, Excel, pagination, and totals represent one complete filtered queryset with correct units and unset semantics.

resolvedDefects.title: Client-side aggregation on page slice instead of whole queryset
resolvedDefects.resolution: ActivityLogView and ProjectActivityLog UI aggregate across the complete filtered queryset. Totals are page-invariant across pages 1 and 2.

resolvedDefects.title: Missing whole-queryset totals/aggregates payload in ActivityLogView API
resolvedDefects.resolution: API exposes totals payload covering row headcount sum, unit-grouped quantities (m², m³, etc.), distinct from unmeasured/missing units.

resolvedDefects.title: Missing discipline, block, and contractor filters on Daily Reports list
resolvedDefects.resolution: Discipline, block, and contractor dropdown filters implemented on Daily Reports list adhering to same-row matching and split-row exclusion.

resolvedDefects.title: Collapsing unset/unmeasured quantities into numeric zero
resolvedDefects.resolution: Distinction between measured numeric zero (0) and unset/unknown quantities preserved in API, UI tables, and FILE1 exports across FA and EN.

resolvedDefects.title: Misleading man-days labeling for raw headcount row sum
resolvedDefects.resolution: Labels accurately describe raw activity-row headcount sums in Persian and English without conflating man-days.

specAcceptanceCriteria.SC-001: Passed. Single-row dimension matching, split-row exclusion, summary deduplication, scoped RBAC (403 on unauthorized access), and bidirectional URL filter/page restoration verified in FA/RTL and EN/LTR.
specAcceptanceCriteria.SC-002: Passed. 51-row activity fixture verified across 2 pages (50 on page 1, 1 on page 2) with constant headcount 51, 45 m², and 25 m³. FILE1 exports match full 51 rows regardless of page downloaded from.
specAcceptanceCriteria.SC-003: Passed. Distinct rendering of measured zero vs unknown semantics verified in UI and Excel formulas.
specAcceptanceCriteria.SC-004: Passed. Approval-to-visibility commit bracketed within 504.7 ms, cold filtering 374.9 ms, warm filtering 154.8 ms.

verificationSummary.deliveryPlanStatus: Item A.1-B04 is marked implemented in apps/web/src/app/data/delivery-plan.ts. Localhost browser delivery plan verified.

summary: Package B04 (Filters, complete result set, and totals) is fully verified and qa_passed. All historical defects (DEF-B04-01 through DEF-B04-05) are resolved.
